parameters.name: query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {id: '{{ $json.campaignId }}' }) RETURN c.worldState as worldState, c.cascadeHistory as cascadeHistory, c.relationshipGraph as relationships

parameters.name: messages
query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {id: '{{ $json.campaignId }}' }) CREATE (e:Event {id: '{{ $json.cascadeId }}', type: 'cascade', initial_event: {{ JSON.stringify($json.initialEvent) }}, effects: {{ JSON.stringify($json.cascadeEffects) }}, current_depth: {{ $json.currentDepth }}, completed: {{ $json.processing_complete }}, timestamp: '{{ $json.lastPropagationTime }}' })-[r:AFFECTS]->(c) RETURN e, r

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {id: '{{ $json.campaignId }}' }) CREATE (b:Branch {id: '{{ $json.branch_id }}', parent_event: '{{ $json.parent_effect_id }}', type: '{{ $json.branch_type }}', priority: {{ $json.priority }}, delay: {{ $json.delay }}, conditions: {{ JSON.stringify($json.conditions) }}, created: timestamp() })-[r:BRANCH_OF]->(c) RETURN b, r

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, cascade_id: $json.cascade_id, effects_processed: $json.cascade_statistics.total_effects_generated, branches_created: $json.cascade_statistics.branches_created, narrative_summary: $json.narrative_summary, player_hooks: $json.player_hooks, cascade_complete: $json.cascade_complete, next_steps: $json.next_steps } }}
